title: Engineering model interpretation and identity checks
description: Interpret supplied state-scoped content, diagnose declared model rules and prepare explicit isolated migration candidates. Existing scoped identity and relationship checks retain their meanings; no operation writes source content, adopts a profile or grants approval.

operations.name: interpret_model_content
operations.purpose: Interpret content using the profile declared for its selected model state.
inputs: Selected model/state identity and raw content with its acquisition scope and completeness.
The state's declared profile identity and available authoritative profile definitions.
outputs: Interpreted content and declared profile with state/scope/completeness, or explicit missing, unsupported, incompatible, incomplete, or failed interpretation.

Identifiable governing interpretation context: applicable entity, field, relationship, cardinality, identity, naming, lifecycle, and validity definitions, directly available or through resolvable references bound to the selected state and profile.
behavior: Use the supplied declaration and applicable profile definitions without silently applying the newest profile.
Interpret identities, record kinds, and authoritative references only within the understood supplied scope.
Preserve incomplete acquisition limits in the result; successful interpretation of a portion does not establish full-state completeness.
Make this operation independent of IF-001 interpreted retrieval; raw content and its declaration are supplied by the caller.

Expose the governing definitions alongside interpretation results. A profile label without accessible rules does not establish an inspectable interpretation context; report unavailable context explicitly.

For read-only allocation diagnostics, expose unambiguous known identities and typed facts with field-specific missing, invalid or unresolved allocation/constraint observations even when the whole model is not valid. Preserve interpretation gaps; unknown or unparseable content cannot establish complete scope. This diagnostic use never accepts a write, repairs a definition or asserts whole-model validity.

failure_behavior.condition: The declaration is absent, definitions unavailable, or a rule/type unsupported.
failure_behavior.outcome: Identify the interpretation gap without changing profiles or migrating the source.

failure_behavior.condition: The content/profile association is inconsistent or interpretation fails.
failure_behavior.outcome: Return the affected subject/state/scope and do not claim a complete valid interpretation.

operations.name: check_candidate_identities
operations.purpose: Determine identity presence and uniqueness in a supplied candidate model scope.
inputs: Candidate model state and its base-state identity.

Interpreted entity definitions forming the proposed resulting view (including the replacement of the same existing subject where applicable), declared profile, required scope, and explicit completeness of that supplied view.
outputs: Missing-identity and duplicate-identity findings with affected definitions, checked state/scope, and complete or incomplete identity-check outcome.
behavior: Require an explicit nonblank identity on every inspected entity.
Compare identities across distinct entities regardless of names, kinds, and locations; equal display names with different identities are permitted.
Report model-wide uniqueness only after the complete required candidate scope is inspected.
Return findings bound to the actual supplied candidate/state; the retaining caller must establish that the same candidate remains applicable at the point of retention.
An update replaces the original occurrence of the same subject in the candidate view; distinct entities must not be omitted or treated as that replacement to conceal duplicate identities.

failure_behavior.condition: A required part of the candidate view is missing or uninterpretable.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report incomplete checking and known findings without a model-wide validity conclusion.

failure_behavior.condition: Identity is absent or shared by distinct entities.
failure_behavior.outcome: Identify the conflicting records and reject identity validity for that candidate.

operations.name: check_candidate_relationships
operations.purpose: Assess the structural validity of an explicit relationship change over its supplied resulting candidate.
inputs: Expected base state, candidate content identity, declared profile and complete required model membership.
Explicit create, replace or remove operation with original fact when applicable, intended typed endpoints and authoritative containment or cross-domain representation.
Interpreted resulting candidate, including unchanged facts needed for endpoint uniqueness, incoming cardinalities and parentage checks; explicit acquisition completeness.
outputs: Complete valid, invalid, unsupported or incomplete relationship-check outcome with findings, checked base/candidate/profile identities and affected scope.
behavior: Reject unknown relationship or operation kinds before endpoint and consistency checks; do not substitute a known type or profile.
Identify missing or ambiguous endpoints and incompatible endpoint kinds using candidate-state identity findings.
Check the complete profile-required cardinality scope, including incoming facts and unchanged entities, against the resulting candidate after removals and replacements.
For parentage, check exactly one permitted parent and acyclic containment with one authoritative representation; an extra inverse or competing parent representation is invalid.
Return findings, candidate/base/profile identities and inspected scope; incomplete or unavailable input cannot produce a complete valid conclusion.
Keep relationship admission separate from whole-model conformance, authority, engineering approval and satisfaction.

failure_behavior.condition: Required profile, identity, incoming cardinality or containment scope cannot be inspected.
failure_behavior.outcome: Return incomplete or unsupported checking with known findings; do not infer validity from a partial candidate.

failure_behavior.condition: The proposal violates a declared type, endpoint, authority representation, cardinality or parentage rule.
failure_behavior.outcome: Return invalid with the conflicting fact and rule; do not retain or repair the proposal implicitly.

operations.name: check_model_conformance
operations.purpose: Diagnose complete selected model rule scope with explicit findings and assessment limits.
inputs: Immutable captured model/state, raw members and membership completeness, exact declared metamodel/profile and governing definitions.
Explicit subject/rule-family scope, prior/proposed states and decision inputs for transition rules where required, and separately supplied judgments with their actual bases.
outputs: Exact checked basis and rule families; actionable violations, unsupported/unassessed dependencies and acquisition/assessment completeness.
Separately attributed supplied judgments and semantic-review needs; no conformance result establishes approval, implementation or satisfaction.
behavior: Apply MOD-003 conformance-and-migration.md: decode/shape/closed-value checks precede dependent identity, naming, parent/cycle, reference and cardinality checks.
Use complete relevant membership including incoming facts; do not infer uniqueness or absence from a partial neighborhood.
Assess lifecycle transitions only with required exact prior/proposed state and decision inputs; preserve valid state-only findings when a transition is unassessed.
Keep known violations separate from completeness; cancellation or unsupported rules cannot become an unqualified conformance claim.
Present supplied engineering judgments with original subject, basis and limitations, exposing mismatches without supplying semantic approval.

failure_behavior.condition: Required acquisition, profile, rule interpretation or supporting basis is missing, ambiguous or unsupported.
failure_behavior.outcome: Return identified unavailable or unassessed scope and any attributable known findings; do not substitute profiles or invent complete success.

failure_behavior.condition: The request is malformed, has unknown operation/rule selectors, or execution is interrupted.
failure_behavior.outcome: Distinguish request rejection from actual violations and partial execution; preserve inspected scope without mutation.

operations.name: prepare_model_migration
operations.purpose: Transform an explicitly mapped source into an isolated candidate and report target and consumer readiness limits before controlled adoption.
inputs: Immutable source state/content/membership; exact source and target profiles; explicit finite mapping and intentional semantic-change basis.
Declared consumer inventory/completeness, compatibility criteria and actual candidate-bound observations or accountable judgments; unavailable support remains explicit.
outputs: Identified complete or unresolved target candidate and source-to-target transformation report with preserved identities, facts and intentional changes.
Separate target conformance, semantic-review needs, consumer compatibility and controlled-adoption readiness limits; no source write or implicit adoption.
behavior: Apply the bounded declarative mapping, full source-accounting and isolated target construction in MOD-003 conformance-and-migration.md; unsupported or ambiguous transformations cannot drop or invent content.
Preserve stable identities and relationship meaning for representation-only changes; expose each declared semantic change and unresolved equivalence.
Bind target conformance and consumer evidence to exact candidate/profile/mapping; report missing consumers, stale support and required unassessed checks as readiness gaps.
Return candidate/report for further assessment when unresolved. A complete candidate is not adopted and does not confer change authority.
Cancellation, failure, abandonment or lost response cannot rewrite source/history/current profile; discard only owned private buffers and report actual candidate availability.

failure_behavior.condition: Required acquisition, profile, rule interpretation or supporting basis is missing, ambiguous or unsupported.
failure_behavior.outcome: Return identified unavailable or unassessed scope and any attributable known findings; do not substitute profiles or invent complete success.

failure_behavior.condition: The request is malformed, has unknown operation/rule selectors, or execution is interrupted.
failure_behavior.outcome: Distinguish request rejection from actual violations and partial execution; preserve inspected scope without mutation.

consistency_rules: The operation result identifies the supplied subject, profile, state, and inspected scope. It cannot be reused as a conclusion about a different candidate or revision.
Interpretation and identity-check findings are structural results, distinct from requirement satisfaction, semantic adequacy, and applicable authority.
No call obtains its own inputs by recursively requesting interpreted retrieval from IF-001; consumers provide the raw or interpreted candidate views specified by the operation.
compatibility_rules: Support is explicit for the profile declared by the subject state. Unsupported constructs receive a diagnostic rather than a fallback interpretation.
Changes to interpretation or identity-result meaning require reassessing both storage and authoring consumers and preserving historical-state meaning.

Existing logical operations retain their narrower meanings. conformance-and-migration.md selects pure checker/transformer responsibilities in the proposed local model engine; no public wire format, universal historical-profile support or runtime migration writer is implied.

sources.basis: Derive the conformance boundary from SR-002/FUNC-002 and shared SR-012/FUNC-012; preserve SR-014 separation of structural findings and judgments. Supplied scope avoids circular interpretation dependencies.
Derive single-fact relationship editing, candidate admission and retention boundaries from SR-008. Proposed Design only; no runtime implementation or satisfaction claim.

Derive rule-bound allocation assessment and scope-bound potential-impact result contracts with distinct MOD-004 obligations. Reuse content, interpretation and traversal ownership; proposed Design only.

Derive whole-model diagnostics, separate mechanical/review presentation and source-preserving explicit migration candidates through MOD-003. Reuse capture, interpretation and scoped-check ownership; proposed Design only.
